cards.card_text: Then Solomon says may the words of his petition stay near to the LORD day and night, so that He may uphold the cause of His servant and His people Israel.
cards.verse_text: And may these words with which I have made my petition before the LORD be near to the LORD our God day and night, so that He may uphold the cause of His servant and of His people Israel as each day requires,
cards.snippet: And may these words with which I have made my petition before the LORD be near to the LORD our God day and…

cards.card_text: And He opens with this: “I have heard your prayer and petition before Me.”
cards.verse_text: And the LORD said to him: “I have heard your prayer and petition before Me.
cards.snippet: And the LORD said to him: “I have heard your prayer and petition before Me.

cards.card_text: So instead, they fast and petition their God about it.
cards.verse_text: For I was ashamed to ask the king for an escort of soldiers and horsemen to protect us from our enemies on the road, since we had told him, “The hand of our God is gracious to all who seek Him, but His great anger is against all who forsake Him.” So we fasted and petitioned our God about this, and He granted our request.
cards.snippet: …great anger is against all who forsake Him.” So we fasted and petitioned our God about this, and He granted our request.

cards.card_text: As they drink their wine, the king asks Esther once more what her petition is, with the same offer of up to half the kingdom.
cards.verse_text: And as they drank their wine, the king said to Esther, “What is your petition?

Then Jeremiah pleads, “But now please listen, O my lord the king.” Here's his petition: “Do not send me back to the house of Jonathan the scribe, or I will die there.”
cards.verse_text: May my petition come before you.
cards.snippet: May my petition come before you.

cards.card_text: For thirty days, the decree says, nobody can petition any god or man except one.
cards.verse_text: All the royal administrators, prefects, satraps, advisers, and governors have agreed that the king should establish an ordinance and enforce a decree that for thirty days anyone who petitions any god or man except you, O king, will be thrown into the den of lions.

cards.card_text: They tell the king Daniel shows no regard for him or his decree, and he still makes his petition three times a day.
cards.verse_text: He still makes his petition three times a day.”
cards.snippet: He still makes his petition three times a day.”

cards.card_text: So Daniel turns his attention to the Lord God, to seek Him by prayer and petition.
cards.verse_text: So I turned my attention to the Lord God to seek Him by prayer and petition, with fasting, sackcloth, and ashes.
cards.snippet: …my attention to the Lord God to seek Him by prayer and petition, with fasting, sackcloth, and ashes.

cards.card_text: Daniel says they bring their petitions before God because of their own righteous acts.
cards.verse_text: For we are not presenting our petitions before You because of our righteous acts, but because of Your great compassion.

cards.card_text: Daniel is STILL praying, still confessing his own sin and the sin of his people Israel, still bringing his petition about God's holy mountain.
cards.verse_text: While I was speaking, praying, confessing my sin and that of my people Israel, and presenting my petition before the LORD my God concerning His holy mountain—
cards.snippet: …confessing my sin and that of my people Israel, and presenting my petition before the LORD my God concerning His holy mountain—

cards.card_text: Gabriel says an answer to Daniel's prayer went out at the beginning of his petitions.
cards.verse_text: At the beginning of your petitions, an answer went out, and I have come to tell you, for you are highly precious.

cards.card_text: And she continues night and day in her petitions and prayers.
cards.verse_text: The widow who is truly in need and left all alone puts her hope in God and continues night and day in her petitions and prayers.
cards.snippet: …puts her hope in God and continues night and day in her petitions and prayers.

cards.card_text: He offered up prayers and petitions with loud cries and tears.
cards.verse_text: During the days of Jesus’ earthly life, He offered up prayers and petitions with loud cries and tears to the One who could save Him from death, and He was heard because of His reverence.
